thread:
Maya: Quick heads-up — trying to onboard halcyon-v1 into the catalog. weights are at s3://rw-weights/halcyon/v1/halcyon_v1-q8.pt. ran basic validation but hit a tokenizer mismatch on the roundtrip test (2 failures / 1000 samples). can we gate the catalog pin until we understand?

Tom: Thanks. can you paste the exact validation command + checksum? i'll run the checksum and the sanitize job.

Maya: checksum: sha256:9f7e1b2c8a4d5e6f3b2c4d6f7a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9
Validation command I used:
```
python infra/model_checks.py --weights s3://rw-weights/halcyon/v1/halcyon_v1-q8.pt --tokenizer s3://rw-tokenizers/halcyon/v1/tokenizer.json --samples 1000 --roundtrip
```
Output snippet: "roundtrip_failures=2, avg_token_len_in=18.3, avg_token_len_out=18.1"

Liam: 2/1000 is low but not zero. do we know if the failures are whitespace vs special-char splitting? last time a mismatch like that was due to tokenizer special unicode normalizer. can you attach failing examples?

Maya: attaching inline: 
- input: "café-au-lait — 50%" -> tokenized vs detokenized differs (dash vs emdash)
- input: "foo\u200bbar" -> zero-width joiner dropped on decode

Anika: those are classic unicode normalizer issues. we should run the tokenizer with NFKC normalization op disabled and compare. also confirm the tokenizer version in the bundle matches the one listed in model_metadata.json.

Maya: model_metadata.json excerpt: 
```json
{"model_name": "halcyon", "version": "v1", "tokenizer": {"name": "bytepiece-unicode", "version": "2025-09-01"}, "pin": null}
```
I think pin is currently null because we haven't added the catalog entry yet.

Priya: For catalog rollout we should pin to a specific model artifact id (not just v1). Suggest pin: "halcyon@2025-11-03-9f7e1b" so we can roll back. also add a fallback to halcyon@2024-12-stable for low-tier plans while canarying on prod.

Josh: +1 on explicit artifact pin. also propose region canary: start in us-west-2 at 5% traffic, monitor latency/error, then enable eu-west-1 if stable. keep ap-southeast-1 off for now.

Maya: updated plan: pin halcyon@2025-11-03-9f7e1b, canary: us-west-2 5% (12h), health checks: token_roundtrip <= 0.5% failures, p50 latency < 120ms, p99 < 600ms. fallback variant: halcyon@2024-12-stable.

Liam: i'll run tokenizer normalize variations and push a patch to tokenizer repo if needed. can you add the failing samples to a gist? makes it faster.

Maya: gist: https://gist.github.com/maya/halcyon-tokenizer-fails — contains minimal repro and commands.

Anika: catalog config snippet to apply (please review):
```yaml
- model: halcyon
  pin: halcyon@2025-11-03-9f7e1b
  canaries:
    - region: us-west-2
      traffic_pct: 5
      duration: 12h
      health_checks:
        - name: token_roundtrip
          threshold: 0.5
        - name: p99_latency_ms
          threshold: 600
  fallback: halcyon@2024-12-stable
  enabled_regions: [us-west-2]
```

Tom: config looks fine. i'll queue the catalog PR but leave the region list minimal until infra gives green. also add a lint rule to ensure pin is non-null for hosted models.

infra-bot: catalog-lint: SUCCESS for halcyon (schema ok) — awaiting manual review for region enablement.

Sasha: infra note — we'll need to pre-warm KV cache and ensure quantized kernel available on us-west-2 GPU fleet. @deploy-bot can we schedule a pre-warm job?

deploy-bot: Scheduled pre-warm job for halcyon@2025-11-03-9f7e1b in us-west-2, ETA 20m. job_id=prewarm-7890

Priya: also, add a trace-level eval set for the canary to detect behavioral regressions vs halcyon@2024-12-stable. small prompt set (50 prompts) with semantic similarity checks.

Maya: added eval set and linked to the PR. once tokenizer roundtrips are fixed (or explained) i'll flip the PR to ready-for-merge.

Tom: if tokenizer patch required, timeline?

Liam: estimate 1 day to triage + push patch, 2-3 hours for release & validation. i'll start now.

Maya: thanks all — i'll hold the catalog pin until we confirm tokenizer fails are non-regressive or patched. will update thread when pre-warm + canary start. :thumbsup:
